s0201.literal: On gengshen day, because of receiving the honorific title, reverent thanksgiving was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0201.idiomatic: On gengshen day, because of receiving the honorific title, reverent thanksgiving was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0202.literal: On xinyou day Sichuan Branch Secretariat forces campaigning against Yunnan advanced to Wumeng.
s0202.idiomatic: On xinyou day Sichuan Branch Secretariat forces campaigning against Yunnan advanced to Wumeng.

s0203.literal: On renxu day in Qiao County of Guide Prefecture fog damaged the wheat.
s0203.idiomatic: On renxu day in Qiao County of Guide Prefecture fog damaged the wheat.

s0204.literal: On guihai day Sichuan troops reached Snow Mountain Gorge in Yunnan, encountered Luoluo forces, and defeated them.
s0204.idiomatic: On guihai day Sichuan troops reached Snow Mountain Gorge in Yunnan, encountered Luoluo forces, and defeated them.

s0205.literal: Dezhou had famine; they were relieved with three thousand ingots of Shandong salt duty notes.
s0205.idiomatic: Dezhou had famine; they were relieved with 3,000 ingots of Shandong salt duty notes.

s0206.literal: Wuchang Route had famine; they were relieved with fifty thousand shi of grain and two thousand ingots of notes.
s0206.idiomatic: Wuchang Route had famine; they were relieved with 50,000 shi of grain and 2,000 ingots of notes.

s0207.literal: On jiazi day Yan Temür was again appointed central secretariat right chancellor, with an edict proclaimed to the realm.
s0207.idiomatic: On jiazi day Yan Temür was again appointed central secretariat right chancellor, with an edict proclaimed to the realm.

s0208.literal: Forty thousand ingots of notes were distributed to palace women; the Grand Princess of Lu was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0208.idiomatic: 40,000 ingots of notes were distributed to palace women; the Grand Princess of Lu was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0209.literal: On dingmao day the Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy completed compiling the Veritable Records of Emperor Yingzong.
s0209.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy completed compiling the Veritable Records of Emperor Yingzong.

s0210.literal: On wuchen day the imperial procession set out from Dadu and halted at Dagu.
s0210.idiomatic: On wuchen day the imperial procession set out from Dadu and halted at Dagu.

s0211.literal: Shangshe Temple was promoted to rank 3a.
s0211.idiomatic: Shangshe Temple was promoted to rank 3a.

s0212.literal: Alinj Temür was appointed grand minister of husbandry.
s0212.idiomatic: Alinj Temür was appointed grand minister of husbandry.

s0213.literal: Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri was dispatched to guard the western Tibetans and was granted a gold seal.
s0213.idiomatic: Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri was dispatched to guard the western Tibetans and was granted a gold seal.

s0214.literal: Prince Tuohuan was granted a gold seal; grand minister of husbandry Buralanxi was granted a silver seal.
s0214.idiomatic: Prince Tuohuan was granted a gold seal; grand minister of husbandry Buralanxi was granted a silver seal.

s0215.literal: Zhao Shiyan was advanced to Hanlin academician expositor and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.
s0215.idiomatic: Zhao Shiyan was advanced to Hanlin academician expositor and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.

s0216.literal: Famine households in Weihui, Daming, and Luzhou were relieved with six thousand ingots of notes and five thousand shi of grain.
s0216.idiomatic: Famine households in Weihui, Daming, and Luzhou were relieved with 6,000 ingots of notes and 5,000 shi of grain.

s0217.literal: Troops of the Huligai wanhu prefecture in Kaiyuan Route and the Qachi chiliarchate in Ningxia Route who were suffering famine were each given one month's relief grain.
s0217.idiomatic: Troops of the Huligai wanhu prefecture in Kaiyuan Route and the Qachi chiliarchate in Ningxia Route who were suffering famine were each given 1 month's relief grain.

s0218.literal: On jiwei day the court halted at Longhu Terrace.
s0218.idiomatic: On jiwei day the court halted at Longhu Terrace.

s0219.literal: One tutor, commandant, and marshal each were established for Prince Suo Kunche.
s0219.idiomatic: 1 tutor, commandant, and marshal each were established for Prince Suo Kunche.

s0220.literal: On xinwei day the Xuanzhong Imperial Guard Army Commander-in-Chief's Office was established, rank 3a, overseeing Alan troops, subordinate to the Privy Council.
s0220.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Xuanzhong Imperial Guard Army Commander-in-Chief's Office was established, rank 3a, overseeing Alan troops, subordinate to the Privy Council.

s0221.literal: Grand director of the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Office Yiliechi was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0221.idiomatic: Grand director of the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Office Yiliechi was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0222.literal: Five thousand three hundred seventy households of Left and Right Qipchaq and Dragon Escort guard soldiers who were suffering famine — each household was relieved with two ingots of notes, one bolt of cloth, and one month's grain.
s0222.idiomatic: 5,370 households of Left and Right Qipchaq and Dragon Escort guard soldiers who were suffering famine — each household was relieved with 2 ingots of notes, 1 bolt of cloth, and 1 month's grain.

s0223.literal: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched to comfort the army in Yunnan.
s0223.idiomatic: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched to comfort the army in Yunnan.

s0224.literal: At the time Prince Tula leading wanhu Hudurlu Sha, Qielie, Boluo, and others all commanded troops to advance and attack Tuojian and Bohu.
s0224.idiomatic: At the time Prince Tula leading wanhu Hudurlu Sha, Qielie, Boluo, and others all commanded troops to advance and attack Tuojian and Bohu.

s0225.literal: On jiaxu day ten thousand men of the Eight Fan Guaixi Miao led by Ama, Chabo Zhi, and others raided the borderlands; an order commanded privy council officials to divide troops and attack them.
s0225.idiomatic: On jiaxu day 10,000 men of the Eight Fan Guaixi Miao led by Ama, Chabo Zhi, and others raided the borderlands; an order commanded privy council officials to divide troops and attack them.

s0226.literal: On yihai day the Shunyuan Pacification Commission was established, overseeing Dalan Khan troops campaigning against Yunnan; each man was granted five ingots of notes.
s0226.idiomatic: On yihai day the Shunyuan Pacification Commission was established, overseeing Dalan Khan troops campaigning against Yunnan; each man was granted 5 ingots of notes.

s0227.literal: In Huizhou of Weihui Route, because of scarcity of grain and seed, three thousand ingots of notes were given to enable purchase in other prefectures.
s0227.idiomatic: In Huizhou of Weihui Route, because of scarcity of grain and seed, 3,000 ingots of notes were given to enable purchase in other prefectures.

s0228.literal: On jimao day envoys were dispatched to Wutai Mountain to perform Buddhist rites.
s0228.idiomatic: On jimao day envoys were dispatched to Wutai Mountain to perform Buddhist rites.

s0229.literal: On gengchen day Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply fifty thousand ingots of notes for Yunnan military needs.
s0229.idiomatic: On gengchen day Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply 50,000 ingots of notes for Yunnan military needs.

s0230.literal: That month the Right Guard left and right hand colony fields had great flood, ruining more than eight hundred qing of grain.
s0230.idiomatic: That month the Right Guard left and right hand colony fields had great flood, ruining more than 800 qing of grain.

s0231.literal: Guangping, Henan, Daming, Panyang, Nanyang, Jining, Dongping, Bianliang and other routes, Gaotang, Kai, Pu, Hui, De, Guan, Hua and other prefectures, and Dayou, Qiansi and other colony fields had locusts.
s0231.idiomatic: Guangping, Henan, Daming, Panyang, Nanyang, Jining, Dongping, Bianliang and other routes, Gaotang, Kai, Pu, Hui, De, Guan, Hua and other prefectures, and Dayou, Qiansi and other colony fields had locusts.

s0232.literal: Because Zhedong Pacification Commissioner Chen Tianyou and Huguang associate administrator Fan Qi died in the ruler's service, enfeoffment titles were specially advanced one grade.
s0232.idiomatic: Because Zhedong Pacification Commissioner Chen Tianyou and Huguang associate administrator Fan Qi died in the ruler's service, enfeoffment titles were specially advanced one grade.

s0233.literal: Zou Shi of Longxing, wife of Zhang Renxing, Cui Shi of Fengyuan, wife of Li Yu — all for recorded integrity; Hua Yin of Bianliang for filial conduct — all had their gates honored.
s0233.idiomatic: Zou Shi of Longxing, wife of Zhang Renxing, Cui Shi of Fengyuan, wife of Li Yu — all for recorded integrity; Hua Yin of Bianliang for filial conduct — all had their gates honored.

s0234.literal: Sixth month, on xinsi new moon, Yan Temür said: "Previously there was an edict permitting only your subject and Bayan concurrently to hold three posts.
s0234.idiomatic: Sixth month, on xinsi new moon, Yan Temür said: "Previously there was an edict permitting only your subject and Bayan concurrently to hold three posts.

s0235.literal: Now Zhao Shiyan as grand councillor concurrently holds Hanlin academician expositor and Kuizhang Pavilion academician, citing illness to resign.
s0235.idiomatic: Now Zhao Shiyan as grand councillor concurrently holds Hanlin academician expositor and Kuizhang Pavilion academician, citing illness to resign.

s0236.literal: " The Emperor said: "We esteem elders; let Shiyan still attend to central secretariat affairs; if he is truly ill, he need not participate in selection and appointment."
s0236.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "We esteem elders; let Shiyan still attend to central secretariat affairs; if he is truly ill, he need not participate in selection and appointment."

s0237.literal: On bingxu day the great procession reached Shangdu.
s0237.idiomatic: On bingxu day the great procession reached Shangdu.

s0238.literal: On wuzi day grain was disbursed to Left and Right Qipchaq and Dragon Escort guard soldiers.
s0238.idiomatic: On wuzi day grain was disbursed to Left and Right Qipchaq and Dragon Escort guard soldiers.

s0239.literal: On renchen day Zhenjiang had famine; four thousand shi of grain were disbursed in relief.
s0239.idiomatic: On renchen day Zhenjiang had famine; 4,000 shi of grain were disbursed in relief.

s0240.literal: Raozhou had famine; relevant offices were also ordered to relieve it.
s0240.idiomatic: Raozhou had famine; relevant offices were also ordered to relieve it.

s0241.literal: On guisi day censorate officials said: "Xuanhui Court money and grain, receipts and disbursements without regularity — for imperial supplies and drink and food, many presumptuously claim without auditing their documents, then abuses daily grow.
s0241.idiomatic: On guisi day censorate officials said: "Xuanhui Court money and grain, receipts and disbursements without regularity — for imperial supplies and drink and food, many presumptuously claim without auditing their documents, then abuses daily grow.

s0242.literal: It would be fitting to follow the old system — report truthfully to the branch secretariat and ministry to prepare for inspection and assessment.
s0242.idiomatic: It would be fitting to follow the old system — report truthfully to the branch secretariat and ministry to prepare for inspection and assessment.

s0244.literal: On bingshen day a mobile privy council was established to campaign against Yunnan; fifteen relay-seal edicts and five silver-character round tallies were granted.
s0244.idiomatic: On bingshen day a mobile privy council was established to campaign against Yunnan; 15 relay-seal edicts and 5 silver-character round tallies were granted.

s0245.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Cherig Temür was made to administer mobile privy council affairs; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tanma Chi and attendant Jiaohua were made associate administrator and vice commissioner.
s0245.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Cherig Temür was made to administer mobile privy council affairs; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tanma Chi and attendant Jiaohua were made associate administrator and vice commissioner.

s0246.literal: Troops of thirteen thousand from Duogan, Duosima, and Gongchang and other places were mobilized; each man was given three horses.
s0246.idiomatic: Troops of 13,000 from Duogan, Duosima, and Gongchang and other places were mobilized; each man was given 3 horses.

s0247.literal: Cherig Temür together with Western Pacification Prince Suosi Ban and others advanced by way of Sichuan; Jiaohua followed Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri and others by way of the Eight Fan — advancing by separate routes.
s0247.idiomatic: Cherig Temür together with Western Pacification Prince Suosi Ban and others advanced by way of Sichuan; Jiaohua followed Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri and others by way of the Eight Fan — advancing by separate routes.

s0248.literal: The Yellow River overflowed; attached counties of Daming Route had five hundred eighty-odd qing of civilian fields inundated.
s0248.idiomatic: The Yellow River overflowed; attached counties of Daming Route had 580-odd qing of civilian fields inundated.

s0249.literal: On gengzi day inner attendant Zhong Ruiqing Sali was appointed grand minister of husbandry; Sichuan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Boluo was granted a gold tiger tally.
s0249.idiomatic: On gengzi day inner attendant Zhong Ruiqing Sali was appointed grand minister of husbandry; Sichuan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Boluo was granted a gold tiger tally.

s0250.literal: Two hundred thousand ingots of salt duty notes were supplied for Yunnan military needs.
s0250.idiomatic: 200,000 ingots of salt duty notes were supplied for Yunnan military needs.

s0251.literal: Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Gansu branch secretariats were ordered to chant the Tripitaka in six hundred fifty sections and grant thirty thousand ingots of notes.
s0251.idiomatic: Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Gansu branch secretariats were ordered to chant the Tripitaka in 650 sections and grant 30,000 ingots of notes.

s0252.literal: Privy council administrator Kuochebo, Totuomuer, transmission commissioner Zhierhalang, Hanlin academician expositor Jiaohua, Bayan Bugan, Yan Wang palace director Jiaohua, Woluosi, central administration commissioner Shangjianu, Tuwutai, right Alan guard commander Nahacha, Baizhu — guilty of plotting rebellion, all were executed in the marketplace and their families were registered.
s0252.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Kuochebo, Totuomuer, transmission commissioner Zhierhalang, Hanlin academician expositor Jiaohua, Bayan Bugan, Yan Wang palace director Jiaohua, Woluosi, central administration commissioner Shangjianu, Tuwutai, right Alan guard commander Nahacha, Baizhu — guilty of plotting rebellion, all were executed in the marketplace and their families were registered.

s0253.literal: On guimao day Boluo of Sichuan led five thousand Mongol gradually registered troops to Yunnan.
s0253.idiomatic: On guimao day Boluo of Sichuan led 5,000 Mongol gradually registered troops to Yunnan.

s0254.literal: On yisi day Luoluo native official Sajiabo joined Wumeng barbarian troops of ten thousand to attack Jianchang County; Yunnan Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Yolqi Temür resisted them, beheading over four hundred heads; Sichuan troops also defeated Sajiabo at Lugu Post Station.
s0254.idiomatic: On yisi day Luoluo native official Sajiabo joined Wumeng barbarian troops of 10,000 to attack Jianchang County; Yunnan Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Yolqi Temür resisted them, beheading over 400 heads; Sichuan troops also defeated Sajiabo at Lugu Post Station.

s0255.literal: On bingwu day Duosima Mongol populace had famine; one month's grain was disbursed in relief.
s0255.idiomatic: On bingwu day Duosima Mongol populace had famine; 1 month's grain was disbursed in relief.

s0256.literal: On dingwei day the Eastern Route Mongol Army Marshal's Office was changed to the Eastern Route Qipchaq Army Wanhu Office.
s0256.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Eastern Route Mongol Army Marshal's Office was changed to the Eastern Route Qipchaq Army Wanhu Office.

s0257.literal: That month Gaotang, Cao Prefecture and front, rear, and military guard colony fields had flood disaster.
s0257.idiomatic: That month Gaotang, Cao Prefecture and front, rear, and military guard colony fields had flood disaster.

s0258.literal: Dadu, Yidu, Zhending, Hejian and other routes, Xian, Jing, Tai'an and other prefectures, and left capital might guard colony fields had locusts.
s0258.idiomatic: Dadu, Yidu, Zhending, Hejian and other routes, Xian, Jing, Tai'an and other prefectures, and left capital might guard colony fields had locusts.

s0259.literal: Three thousand four hundred famine-stricken Mongol people in the remote north — each person was given two shi of grain and two bolts of cloth.
s0259.idiomatic: 3,400 famine-stricken Mongol people in the remote north — each person was given 2 shi of grain and 2 bolts of cloth.

s0260.literal: Li Shi, wife of Liang Ziyi of Zhending, and others for chastity; Hu Juren of Xuzhou for filial conduct — all were honored at their gates.
s0260.idiomatic: Li Shi, wife of Liang Ziyi of Zhending, and others for chastity; Hu Juren of Xuzhou for filial conduct — all were honored at their gates.

s0261.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day Prince Anhunqa was enfeoffed Prince of Guangning and granted a gold seal.
s0261.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day Prince Anhunqa was enfeoffed Prince of Guangning and granted a gold seal.

s0262.literal: On renzi day western monks were ordered to perform prayer for the stars.
s0262.idiomatic: On renzi day western monks were ordered to perform prayer for the stars.

s0263.literal: On bingchen day Kuochebo's grand minister of husbandry seal was granted to Sali.
s0263.idiomatic: On bingchen day Kuochebo's grand minister of husbandry seal was granted to Sali.

s0264.literal: On dingsi day central secretariat and Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy officials were ordered to sacrifice to the portrait effigies of the Founding Ancestor, Taizong, and Ruizong at the Great Universal Blessings Monastery.
s0264.idiomatic: On dingsi day central secretariat and Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy officials were ordered to sacrifice to the portrait effigies of the Founding Ancestor, Taizong, and Ruizong at the Great Universal Blessings Monastery.

s0265.literal: Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites for the Yan Wang crown prince.
s0265.idiomatic: Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites for the Yan Wang crown prince.

s0266.literal: Western-region prince Busein dispatched envoys to come to court in congratulation.
s0266.idiomatic: Western-region prince Busein dispatched envoys to come to court in congratulation.

s0267.literal: Supervising censor requested that confiscated garments of Kuochebo be distributed to guard soldiers — approved.
s0267.idiomatic: Supervising censor requested that confiscated garments of Kuochebo be distributed to guard soldiers — approved.

s0268.literal: On jiwei day Kuochebo's residence was granted to the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Office; garments were granted to ministers.
s0268.idiomatic: On jiwei day Kuochebo's residence was granted to the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Office; garments were granted to ministers.

s0269.literal: Tongwei mountain collapsed, crushing civilians' dwellings; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve twelve disaster-affected households.
s0269.idiomatic: Tongwei mountain collapsed, crushing civilians' dwellings; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve 12 disaster-affected households.

s0270.literal: On gengshen day Totuomuer's family property was registered and delivered to the inner treasury.
s0270.idiomatic: On gengshen day Totuomuer's family property was registered and delivered to the inner treasury.

s0271.literal: On xinyou day Hasihan Wanhu Office was changed to a chief office, rank 4b.
s0271.idiomatic: On xinyou day Hasihan Wanhu Office was changed to a chief office, rank 4b.

s0272.literal: Edict: "Monks, Daoists, hunters, and falcon-keepers entitled to receive seal edicts — the Hanlin Academy must not report them to the central secretariat without authorization."
s0272.idiomatic: Edict: "Monks, Daoists, hunters, and falcon-keepers entitled to receive seal edicts — the Hanlin Academy must not report them to the central secretariat without authorization."

s0273.literal: In Pingji of Zhending Route, Feixiang of Guangping Route, Quyang and Xingtang of Baoding Route and other counties, great wind, rain, and hail damaged crops.
s0273.idiomatic: In Pingji of Zhending Route, Feixiang of Guangping Route, Quyang and Xingtang of Baoding Route and other counties, great wind, rain, and hail damaged crops.

s0274.literal: Populace and livestock presented by the tribes of Shisitaiqie, Yuejinshenboike, and others — an order commanded that they be compensated at value.
s0274.idiomatic: Populace and livestock presented by the tribes of Shisitaiqie, Yuejinshenboike, and others — an order commanded that they be compensated at value.

s0275.literal: Troops of Jiangxi Jianchang Wanhu Office garrisoning Guanghai served one-year rotations, toiling coming and going; an edict restored the Zhiyuan old system of rotation every two years.
s0275.idiomatic: Troops of Jiangxi Jianchang Wanhu Office garrisoning Guanghai served 1-year rotations, toiling coming and going; an edict restored the Zhiyuan old system of rotation every 2 years.

s0276.literal: On yichou day Hanlin academician expositor Ye'erjini was made privy council administrator.
s0276.idiomatic: On yichou day Hanlin academician expositor Ye'erjini was made privy council administrator.

s0277.literal: Various guard soldiers were mobilized to build the embankments of Huozhou Willow Forest Haizi.
s0277.idiomatic: Various guard soldiers were mobilized to build the embankments of Huozhou Willow Forest Haizi.

s0278.literal: On bingyin day Mongol commoners who reached Shangdu because of famine shortage had their numbers inspected and travel grain given, enabling each to return to their districts.
s0278.idiomatic: On bingyin day Mongol commoners who reached Shangdu because of famine shortage had their numbers inspected and travel grain given, enabling each to return to their districts.

s0279.literal: Dadu relief-sale grain was increased by fifty thousand shi.
s0279.idiomatic: Dadu relief-sale grain was increased by 50,000 shi.

s0280.literal: In Shunzhou and Dong'anzhou of Dadu great wind, rain, and hail damaged crops.
s0280.idiomatic: In Shunzhou and Dong'anzhou of Dadu great wind, rain, and hail damaged crops.

s0281.literal: On wuchen day Princess Shouning died; her seal was taken back.
s0281.idiomatic: On wuchen day Princess Shouning died; her seal was taken back.

s0282.literal: On jiwei day Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to convey one hundred thousand ingots of notes to Yunnan to increase military supplies.
s0282.idiomatic: On jiwei day Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to convey 100,000 ingots of notes to Yunnan to increase military supplies.

s0283.literal: On gengwu day Jupiter encroached upon the Dixiu constellation.
s0283.idiomatic: On gengwu day Jupiter encroached upon the Dixiu constellation.

s0284.literal: Kaiyuan Route had hail that damaged crops.
s0284.idiomatic: Kaiyuan Route had hail that damaged crops.

s0285.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "In recent years the treasury and granaries are empty; expenditures have five kinds: bounty grants, Buddhist rites, establishing government offices, presumptuous claims for disbursement, and continually adding guard soldiers and falcon-keepers.
s0285.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "In recent years the treasury and granaries are empty; expenditures have 5 kinds: bounty grants, Buddhist rites, establishing government offices, presumptuous claims for disbursement, and continually adding guard soldiers and falcon-keepers.

s0286.literal: We request jointly with the Privy Council, Censorate, and officials of each keshig to add rigorous reduction.
s0286.idiomatic: We request jointly with the Privy Council, Censorate, and officials of each keshig to add rigorous reduction.

s0288.literal: Censorate officials memorialized that the newly appointed Henanfu chief administrator Zhang Jujing avoided difficulty and did not go to office; an edict stripped the post he had been granted and increased his punishment with flogging.
s0288.idiomatic: Censorate officials memorialized that the newly appointed Henanfu chief administrator Zhang Jujing avoided difficulty and did not go to office; an edict stripped the post he had been granted and increased his punishment with flogging.

s0289.literal: On jiaxu day princes Yangqietemür, Boluotai, Zhengjisi, Cha'aowuhan and others were granted gold, silver, and notes in graded amounts.
s0289.idiomatic: On jiaxu day princes Yangqietemür, Boluotai, Zhengjisi, Cha'aowuhan and others were granted gold, silver, and notes in graded amounts.

s0290.literal: On bingzi day an imperial command directed central secretariat and censorate to dispatch officials to Jiangzhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan branch secretariats to transfer and appoint officials below rank 3b.
s0290.idiomatic: On bingzi day an imperial command directed central secretariat and censorate to dispatch officials to Jiangzhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan branch secretariats to transfer and appoint officials below rank 3b.

s0291.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered that within next year's tea and salt certificates eight myriad ingots of notes be given to increase military supplies for campaigning against Yunnan.
s0291.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered that within next year's tea and salt certificates 80,000 ingots of notes be given to increase military supplies for campaigning against Yunnan.

s0292.literal: Nine relay stations from Mulin, Zhali to Kuyanbo and others — each station five hundred ingots of notes — were relieved.
s0292.idiomatic: 9 relay stations from Mulin, Zhali to Kuyanbo and others — each station 500 ingots of notes — were relieved.

s0293.literal: Grain disbursement to garrison troops at Juyong Pass was increased.
s0293.idiomatic: Grain disbursement to garrison troops at Juyong Pass was increased.

s0294.literal: Sea tide overflowed, washing away two hundred sixty-seven thousand-odd yin of Hejian transport commission salt.
s0294.idiomatic: Sea tide overflowed, washing away 267,000-odd yin of Hejian transport commission salt.

s0295.literal: On dingchou day five relay-seal edicts and two silver-character round tallies were additionally granted to Shaanxi Mongol Commander-in-Chief's Office for campaigning against Yunnan.
s0295.idiomatic: On dingchou day 5 relay-seal edicts and 2 silver-character round tallies were additionally granted to Shaanxi Mongol Commander-in-Chief's Office for campaigning against Yunnan.

s0296.literal: Former Chancellor Temuder's son director of imperial construction Suozhu together with his younger brother Guanyinnu and brother-in-law imperial physician Yeliya — on charges of resentment, forging talisman records, sacrificing to the Northern Dipper, and cursing — when the matter came to light, an edict commanded the central secretariat to try them.
s0296.idiomatic: Former Chancellor Temuder's son director of imperial construction Suozhu together with his younger brother Guanyinnu and brother-in-law imperial physician Yeliya — on charges of resentment, forging talisman records, sacrificing to the Northern Dipper, and cursing — when the matter came to light, an edict commanded the central secretariat to try them.

s0297.literal: The matter implicated former Ministry of Justice minister Umaer, former censor-in-chief Boluo, Shangdu defender Maer, and Yeliya's elder sister Anaximus and others — all were executed.
s0297.idiomatic: The matter implicated former Ministry of Justice minister Umaer, former censor-in-chief Boluo, Shangdu defender Maer, and Yeliya's elder sister Anaximus and others — all were executed.

s0298.literal: In Yunnan Tuojian, Bohu, and others grew increasingly fierce; Wusa Luzhu also took advantage to link with Wumeng, Dongchuan, Mangbu, and other barbarians, intending to have Bohu's younger brother Baiyan and others lead troops to attack Shunyuan.
s0298.idiomatic: In Yunnan Tuojian, Bohu, and others grew increasingly fierce; Wusa Luzhu also took advantage to link with Wumeng, Dongchuan, Mangbu, and other barbarians, intending to have Bohu's younger brother Baiyan and others lead troops to attack Shunyuan.

s0299.literal: Privy council officials reported it; an edict immediately dispatched envoys to supervise Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri and the mobile privy council, Sichuan and Yunnan branch secretariats urgently to assemble all armies and advance by separate routes to attack — because Wumeng, Wusa, and Luoluo territories border western Tibetans and adjoin Dangmen Pacification Office as lip and teeth, the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to supervise subordinate troops and people to strictly strengthen defenses; also Gongchang Commander-in-Chief's Office was ordered to transfer one thousand troops to garrison Sichuan.
s0299.idiomatic: Privy council officials reported it; an edict immediately dispatched envoys to supervise Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri and the mobile privy council, Sichuan and Yunnan branch secretariats urgently to assemble all armies and advance by separate routes to attack — because Wumeng, Wusa, and Luoluo territories border western Tibetans and adjoin Dangmen Pacification Office as lip and teeth, the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to supervise subordinate troops and people to strictly strengthen defenses; also Gongchang Commander-in-Chief's Office was ordered to transfer 1,000 troops to garrison Sichuan.

s0300.literal: Kaiyuan, Datong, Zhending, Jining, Guangping routes and loyal assistant guard left and right colony fields — from summer to this month there was no rain.
s0300.idiomatic: Kaiyuan, Datong, Zhending, Jining, Guangping routes and loyal assistant guard left and right colony fields — from summer to this month there was no rain.
